heading: Exclusive right to name, seals, emblems, and badges
lead: The corporation has the exclusive right to use the name “National Conference on Citizenship” and seals, emblems, and badges the corporation adopts.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15070736:446.Aug. 13, 1953, ch. 427, § 16, 67 Stat. 565. The word “sole” is omitted as unnecessary and for consistency in the revised title.
